title: mattia angustifolia
intro: Mattia angustifolia, commonly known as Chinese angelica tree or Chinese angelica, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Mattia angustifolia include its ability to alleviate menstrual disorders, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Mattia angustifolia include lignans, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
